configuration.absolute_amplitude: power dBFS, 10*log10(max(power,1e-12)); no event normalization; fixed plot range -100 to 0 dBFS
configuration.channels: arithmetic mono mean for descriptive analysis only
configuration.transient_map: positive dB excursion above per-frequency baseline median
configuration.visual_axes: all sources share -100..100 ms, 20..2000 Hz, -100..0 dBFS

descriptors: attack power and attack/full-window concentration by frozen frequency region
positive spectral flux magnitude, strongest-flux time, and frequency of maximum positive change
original-Bass versus mix transient-map cosine in 30..500 Hz
absolute time difference between original-Bass and mix strongest 30..500-Hz flux

drum_control.coincidence: nearest already-authorized Drum EME within 0.030 seconds
drum_control.strong_drum: coincident Drum EME whose original-overhead 20..2000-Hz peak spectral flux is at or above the prospectively specified median across all 909 Drum EME
drum_control.report: observable NEITHER fractions overall, without Drum coincidence, and without strong Drum coincidence

observability_criterion.event_observable: original Bass 30..500-Hz attack contrast >= 6 dB AND mix 30..500-Hz attack contrast >= 3 dB AND original/mix transient-map cosine >= 0.50 AND strongest low-frequency flux times differ <= 0.020 s
observability_criterion.interpretation: potentially usable location-associated mixed-audio structure; not instrument identity or physical-onset Ground Truth

outcome_gates.YES: NEITHER observable fraction >= 0.25 AND NEITHER observable-without-strong-Drum fraction >= 0.10 AND NEITHER observable fraction >= 0.50 * BOTH observable fraction
outcome_gates.NO: NEITHER observable fraction < 0.10 OR NEITHER observable-without-strong-Drum fraction < 0.05
outcome_gates.INDETERMINATE: authority, partition, computation, visualization, or replay failure; otherwise intermediate evidence not satisfying YES or NO

visualization_selection.aggregate: population median absolute dBFS maps for Original Bass, controlled Mix, htdemucs_ft Bass, and RX Bass for BOTH and NEITHER
visualization_selection.examples: two identities per BOTH and NEITHER having the smallest SHA-256(identity) values; selection is independent of descriptors and outcome
